## R

Calculate the average of all of the integers from 1 to 10.

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_1_r
______(1:10)
```

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_1_r
#| check: true
if (identical(.result, mean(1:10))) {
  list(correct = TRUE, message = "Nice work!")
} else {
  list(correct = FALSE, message = "That's incorrect, sorry.")
}
```
